description: Create an async insight report for large data queries. Returns a report_run_id to poll with get_async_report.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to query (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

breakdowns.description: Breakdown dimensions: age,gender,country,region,publisher_platform,platform_position,device_platform,comscore_market (replaces dma). Some accounts must opt in in Ads Manager for impression_device, hourly_stats_aggregated_by_audience_time_zone, and frequency_value; empty results do not necessarily mean zero performance.

date_preset.description: Lowercase date preset, for example: today, yesterday, last_7d, last_14d, last_30d, this_month, last_month, this_quarter, last_quarter, this_year, last_year

name: create_async_report
